name: TeamStarWolf - The Year 2016 in Intrusions
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. ATT&CK Enterprise techniques that the verified 2016 record supports: the DHS and FBI GRIZZLY STEPPE report JAR-16-20296A, the July 2018 GRU indictment, WADA, Unit 42 on Shamoon 2, BAE on Bangladesh Bank, US-CERT TA16-091A, TA16-132A and TA16-288A, CISA AA18-337A on SamSam, the FTC on Uber, Yahoo's filing, vendor bulletins, and the ATT&CK objects G0007 APT28, G0082 APT38, S0140 Shamoon, S0370 SamSam, S0604 Industroyer and campaign C0025. Each comment names source numbers from case-studies/CHRONICLE_2016.md. Scores: 100 the source or ATT&CK object prints the id, 70 the source describes the behavior and the study assigns the id, 50 only a Reported source supports the behavior, 40 the mapping is Inferred.

techniques.comment: ATT&CK maps Phishing for Information to APT28, whose 2016 Clinton campaign, DNC and DCCC compromises it records as reported (basis: Listed). Sources [9] refer to the Sources table of case-studies/CHRONICLE_2016.md.

Spring 2016: APT28 email leads recipients to change passwords on a fake webmail domain (JAR); ATT&CK maps the sub-technique to APT28 (basis: Listed). Sources [1][9] refer to the Sources table of case-studies/CHRONICLE_2016.md.
APT28 lookalike domains and shortened URLs (JAR, 29 Dec 2016) (basis: Described). Sources [1] refer to the Sources table of case-studies/CHRONICLE_2016.md.

Spear phishing to obtain the IOC-created ADAMS account (WADA, 13 Sep 2016); spear phishing in the Bangladesh Bank conspiracy (DOJ, mapping Inferred) (basis: Described). Sources [14][29] refer to the Sources table of case-studies/CHRONICLE_2016.md.
